texts.summary: Scipion de Gonzague to the Duke of Nevers, 1585-1589 (BnF fr. 4696), and a letter of 1590 by an unestablished writer (fr. 4698). Confidential warnings and cavalry arrangements: horses, payments, dispatches and service in war. The fr. 4698 fragment contains a request for an appeal or intercession, and the Paris letter of 16 February 1590 discusses friendship, the King of Spain and a request; most of both remains unread.
texts.note: The repository holds only the excerpt and translation in George Lasry's report (lasry_entry.md); his full transcription and decryption are his and not yet in the repository, and the ciphertext has not been transcribed here. 24 Oct 2026: 94.6% of the words of lasry_excerpt_reading.md read as sense (v2_score explicit holes); coherent sentences but under the 95% read bar, so read in part.
